---
name: ehr-longitudinal-mini
description: Use host-authorized longitudinal EHR quality and forecast tools with aggregate, provenance-bound outputs.
---

# Longitudinal EHR research

1. Bind every quality audit or forecast request to the approved opaque dataset,
   ruleset, timeline, and artifact identifiers.
2. Check output status, counts, horizon, uncertainty, and validation artifact
   before using a result in a research conclusion.
3. Treat forecasts as bounded research outputs, never patient-level facts or
   clinical instructions.
4. Do not request raw records, free-text charts, identifiers, or data export.
